verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Watchlist Reports can be configured to run at regular intervals (e.g., monthly/yearly) against an account, providing continuous re-screening, and webhooks deliver real-time status update events that ops can act on. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that recurring watchlist reports actually re-trigger webhook events, and explicit documentation tying watchlist changes specifically to webhook payloads rather than general status webhooks.
